You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository sympy/sympy.

Problem Statement:
Title: Missing Rotation Jumps Property Causes Failure in Beam Hinge Application

Description:
When applying a hinge to a beam using the apply_hinge method, the rotation jump symbol is not being properly exposed. In previous versions, using apply_hinge resulted in an AttributeError when trying to access rotation jump data. For example, running code similar to the snippet below:

```
b = Beam(15, 20, 20)
# Setup supports
r0, m0 = b.apply_support(0, type='fixed')
r10 = b.apply_support(10, type='pin')
r15 = b.apply_support(15, type='pin')
# Apply hinges and record rotation symbols
p7 = b.apply_hinge(7)
p12 = b.apply_hinge(12)
# Additional load application and solving
b.apply_load(-10, 7, -1)
b.apply_load(-2, 10, 0, 15)
b.solve_for_reaction_loads(r0, m0, r10, r15)
# Attempt to access rotation jumps
print(b.rotation_jumps[p7])
```

The above code previously fails with the error:
    AttributeError: 'Beam' object has no attribute 'rotation_jumps'

Expected Behavior:
The apply_hinge method is supposed to return the rotation jump symbol, and the Beam object should store a mapping of these symbols in a rotation_jumps property. This would allow subsequent operations to correctly reference the unknown rotation jump, and the tests expecting rotation jump data should pass.

Actual Behavior:
In the old commit version, the rotation_jumps property is missing, which leads to an AttributeError when code attempts to access it.

Please investigate why the rotation jump mapping was not available and ensure that the Beam instance correctly exposes the rotation_jumps property after applying a hinge.

entries.author: teacher
entries.content: Root cause: `Beam.apply_hinge` created the rotation-jump symbol internally and stored the solved values in `self._rotation_jumps`, but it never returned the symbol and there was no public `rotation_jumps` property, so users had no way to reference the jump data (accessing `b.rotation_jumps` raised `AttributeError`). The fix makes `apply_hinge` return the rotation-jump symbol and adds a `rotation_jumps` property exposing `self._rotation_jumps`, with the docstring example updated accordingly. Verified with the issue's example, the full beam test file (21 passed), and the module doctests (the only failure is a pre-existing, environment-related `draw` plotting doctest).
